description: For infinite cardinals kappa and lambda, if every mu less than kappa has mu to the lambda less than kappa and the cofinality of kappa is at most lambda, then kappa to the lambda equals kappa to its cofinality.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ContinuumFunction.power_at_cofinality.{u} (κ τ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (_hτ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ τ) (hsmall : ∀ μ < κ, μ ^ τ < κ) (hcf : κ.ord.cof ≤ τ) : κ ^ τ = κ ^ κ.ord.cof
